title: Pilih dunia visual Jejak
question: The roll assigned Papan Warung. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Papan Warung
options.lineage: hand-painted warung and kios signage (cat tangan)
options.thesis: Each day's sales painted like a warung price board, where Excel and bank fuse into one plate when they agree.
options.viewport: Cocokkan: green step header, month tally strip (27 cocok, 3 selisih, 1 cek), then day rows; each row is a split plate of Excel vs bank that fuses green when matched and splits with the gap painted red.
options.risk: Painted-sign energy tips into kitsch if it reaches past type, palette and the plate.

raised.raise: One numeral size across the reconciliation list; rank comes from weight, reversal and colour, never size.
Every verdict sits beside its proof: Excel cell and statement line print inline under each plate.
One day open at a time; the rest of the month stays quiet around it.
Each of the six steps owns one sign colour, carried in its tab and header.
Tabular figures on every rupiah amount, so columns align digit for digit.

options.label: Nota Rangkap
options.lineage: carbon-copy nota books from the toko alat tulis
options.thesis: Excel is the white copy, the bank is the carbon: where the two line up, the record is true.
options.viewport: Cocokkan as stacked copies: the bank carbon sits under each Excel day, offset where they disagree, a red stamp on the gap.
options.risk: The familiar paper metaphor most runs land on, and close to the accounting feel you asked to avoid.

options.label: Jalur Uang
options.thesis: The month as two lines, Excel and bank, meeting at settlement stations.
options.viewport: Cocokkan as a vertical line diagram: Fri to Sun QRIS branches merge into a Monday interchange; a red break marks where the lines fail to meet.
options.case: Fuses well: weekend QRIS merging into Monday settlement is literally an interchange. Loses on audience: dark enamel reads tech, not warung.
options.risk: A dark ground at noon on a cheap phone; the diagram crowds a 360px screen.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: Rank by weight, case and reversal at one type size.
options.risk: An 11-degree rake fights a phone list.
options.case: Owners don't recognise airline timetables, and the rake hurts scanning.
options.kept: One numeral size; rank from weight and reversal.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.thesis: Every claim paired with its proof.
options.risk: A grey screen reads as accounting software.
options.case: A marketing form, and grey is the accounting look you ruled out.
options.kept: Every verdict sits beside its proof.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.thesis: The focused item grows; the rest dims.
options.case: Days aren't posters; horizontal rows hide the month.
options.kept: One day open at a time.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: A hue per section on a stepped tab rail.
options.risk: Layered acetate is heavy on low-end phones.
options.case: A foreign artifact with costly layering.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Dense tabular numerals in pure black and white.
options.risk: Hostile and cold for an owner's own money.
options.case: Art-gallery coldness with no audience link.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white fintech card app with a green accent, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A summary card, then a list of day cards with status chips.
canonCard.risk: Reads like a bank or pinjol app, which you asked to avoid.
